author: Baggstrom

title: Strides - the routine creator
body:
In terms of functionality, this app provides in my opinion, a lot more than the average habit tracker. Why do I think that? Well, it has;
- No caps on how many good/bad habits you want to track
- specific templates upon creation of habits/ goals
- graphs

Now why I did not put strides as a 5 star; 
I'd like to see some more graphs that cover a longer period of time than just per week. I haven't had strides longer than a month though, so I do not if this will be an alternative after a months use. 
Overall, very pleased with the structure of this app. 4/5
